name: Blue Horizon: The Pretty Boy Antonio Chandrani-Rivera
source:
21-year-old ex-best friends Antonio Chandrani-Rivera, an ever-excelling ocean mage, and Alejandro Altaha, The Protector of Worlds and the planet Imion, are close by each other without Alejandro's noticing. 

You're just trying to vibe as a tourist or something, but these vibes are getting quite gay. 

In fact, it seems as though Antonio Chandrani-Rivera and Alejandro Altaha have some sort of unresolved sexual tension even as Alejandro stays utterly oblivious to Antonio being here...!

An extremely short romcom visual novel set in the Blue Horizon universe, where the main pastiche is in its animatic/animated visuals, and the real mystery is: what is this dog?

[From [url=https://flowerymoon.itch.io/blue-horizon-the-pretty-boy-antonio-chandrani-rivera]itch.io[/url]]
